kpis.label: Reference price
kpis.sub: Band Rs 105-111, lot 135 (company announcement as reported; RHP prints [●]). At Rs 111: 28.93 crore post-issue shares (29.14 crore with ESOPs), market cap Rs 3,212 cr; P/E 33.8x FY26 PAT on diluted shares (49.7x excluding grants and subsidy interest, Rs 65.03 cr); company's own P/E 26.2x (pre-issue weighted shares); P/B 3.1x post-issue; EV/EBITDA 22.1x FY26 operating EBITDA (16.5x on the issuer's KPI EBITDA incl. other income).

focus.title: Bonus issue / share-count consistency
focus.detail: Pre-issue capital 24,42,84,747 shares (p. 108) after a 1:5 split and a 1:3 bonus on 14-Jan-2026; EPS restated for both (p. 170). FY26 basic EPS Rs 4.24 = PAT Rs 95.59 cr on about 22.5 crore weighted shares; on the 24.43 crore pre-issue shares it is Rs 3.91. In Dec-2025 the company issued 2.57 crore shares for KAEHPL and 4.73 crore for Solis Hygiene, both at Rs 22.50 a share (adjusted) to the promoter group and Brainbees (pp. 175-176); the cap of Rs 111 is 4.9x that price eleven months later.

focus.title: Cash flow vs profit
focus.detail: CFO Rs 57.27 / 60.16 / 74.87 cr FY24-26 against PAT Rs 93.97 / 80.67 / 95.59 cr: cumulative CFO 71% of PAT. Inventory and receivables rose with growth; Q1 FY27 CFO Rs 35.15 cr on PAT Rs 16.61 cr was helped by a Rs 63.19 cr rise in trade payables.

focus.title: Related-party capex & subsidiaries
focus.detail: Brainbees Solutions (FirstCry), the 76.59% promoter and a selling shareholder, is the largest customer: 27.03% / 23.45% / 22.64% of revenue FY24-26 and 26.15% in Q1 FY27 (p. 24). Related-party sales Rs 221.1 / 238.0 / 299.5 cr; Brainbees also lends Rs 102.03 cr unsecured at 8%, repayable on demand (p. 45), and pays Swara Hygiene Rs 5.50 cr a year as licensee of a 3.2 lakh sq ft Pithampur property (p. 44). The RHP states all were at arm's length; the dependence is commercial and disclosed.

focus.title: Goodwill vs tangible equity
focus.detail: Goodwill Rs 27.58 cr and intangibles Rs 24.42 cr from the KAEHPL purchase for Rs 57.74 cr in shares (25-Dec-2025); purchase price allocation is provisional (p. 415). KAEHPL's vendor was K.A. Enterprises, a firm of the Birla promoters.

focus.title: Customer / supplier / geographic concentration
focus.detail: Top 10 customers 85.62% / 84.47% / 80.31% of revenue FY24-26, 72.69% in Q1 FY27; top customer (Brainbees) 22.64% FY26. Contract manufacturing is 76-86% of revenue; own brands (Shields, Cuddles) 20.85% FY26 but 9.69% in Q1 FY27 (p. 263). Baby diapers 79% of FY26 product sales (p. 262). Purchase orders can be cancelled without notice (p. 25).

focus.title: Auditor qualifications / changes
focus.detail: Walker Chandiok & Co LLP; unmodified opinion. CARO remarks: database-level audit trail not confirmed, minor delays in statutory dues, loans without repayment schedules, a disputed customs demand of Rs 1.06 cr (FY25), and quarterly bank statements not matching the books (Rs 10.15 cr difference at the company in FY25; KAEHPL in FY26).

focus.title: CARO / audit trail
focus.detail: Government grants and subsidies (MPIDC capital/investment assistance, interest subsidy, TUFS, textile PLI) gave income of Rs 16.00 / 16.61 / 45.24 cr FY24-26 incl. interest income on subsidy: 47.3% of FY26 profit (p. 42). Grant receivables Rs 103.49 cr at Mar-26 (Rs 18.05 cr overdue at Jun-26); schemes run 5-7 years and depend on compliance and disbursement (p. 42).

focus.title: SME conditions
focus.detail: CMD Alok Birla guaranteed loans of SSPPL, a company that defaulted to SBI (classified NPA after 2006); ARCIL settled for Rs 1.00 cr in May-2026 with an 88.7% waiver, and archived CIBIL records (2011-14) still list the matter. A second ARCIL recovery case (PPPL, Rs 1.04 cr) in which he is co-mortgagor is pending before DRT Ahmedabad. Neither involves the company; it is currently not a wilful defaulter (p. 31).

focus.title: Valuation model guard
focus.detail: AMBER: TV above 75% of EV - DCF is mostly a terminal guess

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Pricing terms of the Brainbees supply arrangement and any minimum-offtake commitment

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Capacity and revenue potential of the new Pithampur Project

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Q1 FY26 comparatives (margin and own-brand trend)

focus.title: Data gap (medium)
focus.detail: Expected grant income by scheme and year to expiry

comfort.title: Current vs deferred tax
comfort.detail: Total tax 20.8% / 20.9% / 21.7% of PBT FY24-26; tax paid in cash Rs 20.10 / 19.19 / 16.08 cr (p. 90).

comfort.title: Objects arithmetic as price floor
comfort.detail: Fresh issue up to Rs 500 cr: Rs 198.21 cr part-funds a Rs 554.85 cr Pithampur plant (Rs 234.39 cr already spent by 30-Sep-2026, Rs 100.11 cr of project loans tied up), Rs 100.00 cr repays company debt and Rs 27.50 cr repays subsidiary debt. Up to 35% of gross (about Rs 144 cr at 6% expenses) goes to unidentified acquisitions and general purposes. No proceeds repay the Brainbees loan (p. 164).

comfort.title: Contingent liabilities
comfort.detail: Contingent liabilities only Rs 0.14 cr (customs guarantees). Litigation against the company Rs 0.15 cr (tax) and against subsidiaries Rs 3.24 cr; against promoters 16 tax and 3 regulatory matters, Rs 16.68 cr in all, mostly Brainbees (pp. 33-34).

comfort.title: Monitoring agency
comfort.detail: CRISIL Ratings appointed monitoring agency (agreement dated 19-Oct-2026).

comfort.title: Eligibility re-computation
comfort.detail: Reg 6(1) issue: QIB not more than 50%, NII not less than 15%, retail not less than 35% of the net offer (p. 1).

rows.basis: FY26 after: interest income on subsidy

adjustments.item: Government grant income (MPIDC capital/investment assistance, TUFS, textile PLI) in other income
adjustments.reason: Income from government grants Rs 11.38 / 15.03 / 38.14 cr FY24-26 (p. 90) is 47% of FY26 profit (p. 42). It is real cash over time (grants received Rs 51.79 / 18.69 / 77.59 cr) but scheme-bound: MPIDC assistance runs 7 years and PLI 5 years, disbursement depends on approvals (Rs 18.05 cr overdue at Jun-26), and FY26 includes Rs 13.98 cr accrued for a Swara Hygiene sanction with nothing received by Mar-26 (p. 419). Excluded to show the profit the plants earn on their own.

adjustments.item: Interest income on subsidy (unwinding of discounted grant receivables)
adjustments.reason: Rs 2.21 / nil / 2.70 cr FY24-26 is accounting interest on the present value of future subsidy receivables (p. 42), a non-cash accrual.

adjustments.item: Interest subsidy netted against finance cost
adjustments.reason: Rs 2.42 / 1.58 / 4.40 cr of interest reimbursement is netted against finance cost (p. 42), so reported profit already includes it; removing it would cut profit by that amount. It is tied to the tenure of specific term loans; shown for information, kept out of the adjusted P/E.

adjustments.item: Licence fee from Brainbees for the Pithampur property
adjustments.reason: Rent income Rs 5.50 cr in FY26 from the promoter Brainbees under a leave and licence agreement of 11-Dec-2025 (p. 44); recurring while the agreement runs. For information.

earnings_quality.verdict: Reported FY26 P/E of 33.8x is flattered by the items flagged: adjusted P/E 49.7x (PAT -32.0%). On the FY24-FY26 average, which smooths one-year items, the P/E is 35.9x reported and 44.5x adjusted.
